## Problem and change

Describe the research or contributor workflow affected, the resulting behavior, and related issue/decision links.

## Validation

Record `npm run verify` results and any reruns. For behavior changes, describe the regression test that failed first and the offline fixtures used.

## Checklist

- [ ] Source tracing, explicit gaps and stored-report compatibility are preserved; no ticker-specific branches.
- [ ] CHANGELOG and relevant docs are updated; version stamps are updated where meaning changes (or explain why unnecessary).
- [ ] Relative links resolve and new/moved files are in the release allowlist.
- [ ] No keys, local databases, real provider data or report exports are included.
- [ ] License and attribution notices are preserved.
